title: 第19章 唐越之死第20章 困阵 上
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
林江月收起松芝酒瓶回到屋内。
微醺之下又想试试自己的神识之力，于是使用神识探查杜晓芙院中。
竹影在月色里微微摇曳，杜晓芙院内一片漆黑。
林江月似感到一股巨大的阻力，想要将她隔绝开外。
于是加大神识灵力再次潜入，这次她终于看到两个模糊身影在月色中变得清晰，只是再往里探却无法像上次那般轻易。
收回神识，林江月琢磨缘由。
难道是炼神术架起护盾的原因？
由于神识之力分担了部分给护盾所以无法使用全力？
细想之下，林江月改变策略试着削减护盾之力。
果然能潜入屋内了。
屋内杜晓芙坐在刘芸身后，双掌染着烈火。
刘芸身体不断喷涌热气，身上衣裳汗湿，身材轮廓清晰可见。
林江月徘徊上升，一声怒喝吓得她回首看去。
“是谁！？”
杜晓芙忽的睁眼眺望。
“竟能破下我加强的防御法阵潜入进来。”
林江月的神识快速绕着房梁游荡。
杜晓芙冷哼一声，口中掐诀，顿时屋内黑烟四起，徐徐黑火绕梁而上直追林江月的神识。
林江月奋力游走，那黑火一分二，二分四，将她围个水泄不通。
正当她四处张望寻找出口之时，一张小兽脸庞忽然出现。

无寐？
林江月惊喜之余，眼前一团蓝火似在牵引着她。
它们绕着屋梁飞窜，炽热的黑火紧随其后。
黑火所过之处，浓烟漫起，林江月奋力揉搓视线，眼见就要被浓烟包围。
蓝火绕林江月神识焰火一周，在她周围布下符文护盾。
黑火见状不甘示弱步步紧逼，撕裂符文护盾。
林江月神识抖动想要下潜逃脱。
那团黑火速度极快，将林江月神识堵住。
危急关头，蓝火滋出火焰，在黑火背后凝出一剑，狠狠刺去。
林江月见时机已到，回溯神识到屋中。
镇定片刻，擦掉额头冷汗喃喃自语。
“是无寐，它为何在此？”
为压下波动的神识与惊悸，林江月当即盘膝而坐，宁心静气，运转周天，借吐纳之功稳住心神。
与此同时，在走廊尽头的神兽小院中，无寐睁开双眼，汗珠从下颚滴落，他抖动身子水珠散落空中。
“无寐，刚才真人见你游神没有打扰，待会儿你去一趟前院。”
content_en:
Lin Jiangyue put away the Songzhi bottle and returned to the house.
Being slightly tipsy, he wanted to test the power of his spiritual consciousness, so he used his spiritual consciousness to explore Du Xiaofu's courtyard.
The bamboo shadows swayed slightly in the moonlight, and Du Xiaofu's courtyard was completely dark.
Lin Jiangyue seemed to feel a huge resistance and wanted to isolate her.
So she increased her consciousness and spiritual power and sneaked in again. This time she finally saw two blurry figures becoming clear in the moonlight, but she couldn't look in as easily as last time.
Withdrawing her consciousness, Lin Jiangyue pondered the reason.
Could it be the reason why the refining skills set up a shield?
Because part of the power of divine consciousness is shared with the shield, so I can't use my full strength?
After thinking about it carefully, Lin Jiangyue changed her strategy and tried to reduce the power of the shield.
Sure enough, I was able to sneak into the house.
Du Xiaofu sat behind Liu Yun in the room, her palms filled with fire.
Liu Yun's body was constantly gushing out heat, her clothes were soaked with sweat, and her body contours were clearly visible.
Lin Jiangyue wandered up, and an angry shout scared her to look back.
"Who is it!?"
Du Xiaofu suddenly opened her eyes and looked around.
"You can actually break through my reinforced defensive formation and sneak in."
Lin Jiangyue's consciousness quickly wandered around the beams.
Du Xiaofu snorted coldly and muttered the formula. Suddenly, black smoke filled the room, and black fire slowly circled the beams and chased Lin Jiangyue's consciousness.
Lin Jiangyue struggled to swim away, and the black fire split into two parts, and then divided into four parts, surrounding her.
Just as she was looking around for an exit, a small beast's face suddenly appeared.
No sleep?
Lin Jiangyue was pleasantly surprised, and a ball of blue fire seemed to be pulling her in front of her eyes.
They flew around the rafters, followed by blazing black fire.
Wherever the black fire passed, thick smoke filled the air. Lin Jiangyue struggled to rub her eyes, and saw that she was about to be surrounded by thick smoke.
The blue fire circled Lin Jiangyue's divine consciousness fireworks and laid a rune shield around her.
Seeing this, Blackfire was not willing to be outdone and pressed forward step by step, tearing apart the rune shield.
Lin Jiangyue's consciousness trembled and he wanted to dive down and escape.
The black fire was extremely fast and blocked Lin Jiangyue's consciousness.
At the critical moment, the blue fire spawned flames, condensed a sword behind the black fire, and stabbed hard.
Seeing that the time had come, Lin Jiangyue traced his consciousness back to the house.
After calming down for a moment, he wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and muttered to himself.
"It's Wumei, why is it here?"
In order to suppress the fluctuating consciousness and panic, Lin Jiangyue immediately sat cross-legged, calming her mind, circulating the heavens, and using the power of breathing and breathing to stabilize her mind.
At the same time, in the small courtyard of the mythical beast at the end of the corridor, Wumei opened his eyes, sweat dripped from his chin, and he shook his body as the water dropped into the air.
"Wumei, the real person saw you wandering around just now and didn't bother you. You can go to the front yard later."
